question_text: Passage: 'While the city's revenue increased by 8% this year, its expenditures grew by 12%. This raised concerns about fiscal sustainability among local officials.' What does 'fiscal sustainability' refer to?

options.text: The ability to maintain financial health

hint_ladder.title: Kunin ang Konteksto
hint_ladder.text: Kita lumaki 8%, gastos 12% — ibig sabihin, mas malaki ang labas kaysa pasok. Parang sari-sari store na lugi kung puro utang.

hint_ladder.title: Ano ang 'Fiscal'?
hint_ladder.text: Pera ng gobyerno — kita at gastos. Hindi negosyo, kundi pampublikong pondo. Isaalang-alang kung sustainable ang daloy.

hint_ladder.title: Ano ang 'Sustainability'?
hint_ladder.text: Kayang ituloy nang hindi nauubos. Parang bigas sa bahay — dapat hindi maubos agad. Long-term ang tingin, hindi lang ngayon.

hint_ladder.title: Tanggalin ang Maling Pagpipilian
hint_ladder.text: B, C, D ay mga aksyong posibleng gawin, pero hindi depinisyon. Ang fiscal sustainability mismo ay kakayahang mapanatili ang pinansiyal na kalusugan.

A.text: Correct. Fiscal sustainability means the government's long-term ability to keep its finances healthy and balanced.

B.text: You might have chosen B because increasing taxes is a step to fix poor fiscal health, confusing the action with the definition of the term.

C.text: You might have chosen C because reducing services is a way to cut spending, not the meaning of fiscal sustainability itself.

D.text: You might have chosen D because 'sustainability' sounded like growth, but hiring more staff makes spending worse, the opposite.

next_time_rule: Kapag tinanong ang ibig sabihin, huwag pumili ng solusyon o aksyon—bumalik sa depinisyon ng termino. Fiscal sustainability = matibay na kalusugang pinansiyal.
